findings.title: CREATE2 salt front-running blocks governance deployments
findings.description: The BoxFactory.createBox function allows permissionless CREATE2 deployments using a user-supplied salt. If governance announces a future deployment with a known salt, an attacker can front-run it by calling createBox first with the same salt and parameters. Since CREATE2 enforces salt uniqueness, the governance transaction will revert, causing a denial of service. The attacker gains no control over the Box but can force governance to re-propose with a new salt. The root cause is the lack of salt derivation or access control to prevent unauthorized pre-deployment. The impact is a cheap DoS vector against governance operations, increasing operational friction and cost.
